subject: English
passage: In their attempt to analyze single-walled carbon nanotube structures, Dr. Helena Kowalczyk and colleagues used a field emission electron microscope to direct an electron beam at samples mounted on copper grids. An electromagnetic coil ______ the beam on the center of the 50-nanometer-diameter nanotubes ensured a convergence angle (a measure of beam focusing precision) of 15 milliradians.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it correctly uses the present participle 'focusing' to form a participial phrase that modifies 'electromagnetic coil.' The phrase 'focusing the beam on the center of the 50-nanometer-diameter nanotubes' describes the coil's function and serves as part of the complete subject of the sentence. The main verb 'ensured' establishes that this coil (with its focusing function) ensured a specific convergence angle. This structure avoids creating two independent clauses and maintains proper grammatical form throughout the sentence.
